title: Mexico Eliminated From World Cup, Loses 3-2 to England in Round of 16 Thriller at Azteca
detail: Co-host Mexico's historic World Cup run ended in the Round of 16 at Estadio Azteca, losing 3-2 to England. Jude Bellingham scored twice inside two minutes to put England 2-0 up before Julián Quiñones pulled one back before halftime. England defender Jarrell Quansah was sent off in the 54th minute after a VAR review, and Harry Kane converted a resulting penalty before Raúl Jiménez's second Mexican goal set up a tense finish. England held on with ten men for the final 40 minutes to advance 3-2, dealing Mexico its first defeat at the Azteca in the tournament and ending the co-hosts' deepest World Cup run since 1986.
